summary: A hash-bound five-image exact-structure AQCat25 force-prediction batch was prepared locally for MZ73 review; all structures and requests passed review, and no GPU upload or job submission occurred.

payload.objective: Run the reviewed exact-structure AQCat25 prediction batch for Fe(110) C* + H* -> CH* + * images 02-06 and compare the returned forces against the accepted VASP labels.
current_evidence: The canonical controller prepared image 02-06 AQCat25 prediction requests in aqcat_force_predictions_round_000_sigma0p20_v2.
Each copied POSCAR is byte-identical to its accepted VASP force-label structure, and all five request hashes match the batch manifest.
All five aqcat25_ts_force_prediction_request documents pass the active-learning JSON Schema.
The MZ73 checkpoint path exists and its read-only observed SHA-256 matches the bound checkpoint hash e1f14d50590102dbdf64491a6ae328df6ba0ca2ebb947fbe72213820ae67eb50.
The batch uses portable POSIX relative request paths and automatic_submission=false.
No files were uploaded to MZ73 and no GPU job was submitted.
payload.one_executable_step: Await user review and explicit authorization before uploading and running the exact hash-bound five-image AQCat25 prediction batch on MZ73.
payload.submission_boundary: The current authorization covers local preparation and review only. No MZ73 upload, GPU execution, fine-tuning, additional VASP job, NEB, DIMER, frequency, connectivity, or barrier action is authorized.
done_when: The exact five requests run against the bound checkpoint on MZ73 with producer exit evidence.
Returned predictions pass request, structure, checkpoint, finite-energy, and complete-force-array checks.
The aggregate AQCat25-versus-VASP force assessment is generated locally without promoting predicted or force-label energies to final results.
